purpose: Registry for RunPod Serverless endpoints (B-101 migration). One entry per endpoint = one worker image + one endpoint config + one Model Manager provider mapping. Mirrors helpers/runpod/pod-registry.json for the old pods. Every image/endpoint change MUST be recorded here and reproducible from the Dockerfile + config.
notes: Docker is NOT installed on the dev host. Default builder = GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/build-serverless-worker.yml -> pushes to GHCR (containerRegistry). Repo DaturaInoxia/DreamGenClone is PUBLIC; set GHCR package visibility to Public so RunPod can pull without credentials (or use a read:packages PAT in the endpoint container.imageAuth).
Endpoint API field names (minWorkers/maxWorkers/idleTimeout/gpuIds) verified at P0 against the live RunPod serverless API/console before the first create.
Serverless workers have no SSH. Debugging = build -> deploy -> send job -> read job logs -> iterate.
Migration order: DWPose (infra proof, no app changes) -> Juggernaut (first app-integrated) -> identity -> Qwen VL -> Qwen Edit.
Pods stay running (stopped-not-deleted) as rollback until each endpoint soaks green.

QWEN EDIT MODEL DECISION (2026-08-28): stock qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors is safety-aligned (genital region blanks to 'mannequin'); the pod-side Scottzilla MCNL v1 NSFW LoRA proof FAILED (anatomy confusion). The qwen-edit-worker MUST bake Phr00t/Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO-NSFW-v23 (26.48 GB FP8, ungated: huggingface.co/Phr00t/Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO/resolve/main/v23/Qwen-Rapid-AIO-NSFW-v23.safetensors; SFW sibling v23/Qwen-Rapid-AIO-SFW-v23.safetensors). No runtime LoRA (baked). Load via CheckpointLoaderSimple (model+clip+vae), ~4-8 steps / 1 CFG / euler_ancestral/beta. GGUF NVFP4 variants need Blackwell/CUDA 13+ - dead end on this fleet. Full detail: specs/Planning/B-101-serverless-migration/plan.md MODEL DECISION block.
